signatures.description: Implement the Linearly Transformed Cosines (LTC) area-light integral for a rectangular emitter: clip the rectangle against the visible hemisphere and compute exact GGX specular irradiance for a given view/light frame. Handle partially submerged light polygons via horizon clipping (Sutherland-Hodgman in transformed space) and match reference values to 1e-4 relative error across grazing angles, staying numerically stable when the light plane is nearly parallel to the view direction.
